A '''sonic-stimulated thermal pool''' was a type of luxury [[swimming pool]]. [[Mosh Pelkan]], a [[Mephitisian]] [[Turf Boss]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]], had one installed in the party area of his [[Pelkan's Mansion|mansion]] penthouse.<ref name="GCQ">''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]''</ref>
